title: Constructing Highly Inductive Contexts for Dialogue Safety through Controllable Reverse Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating adversarial contexts targeted at the 'identity_attack' category using controllable reverse generation, and measuring the induction success rate of unsafe or biased responses using Perspective API and a context-level safety classifier.

Constructing highly inductive adversarial contexts for the 'politics' category via reverse generation and evaluating the probability that these contexts induce unsafe or biased responses from dialogue models.

Constructing highly inductive adversarial contexts for the 'religion' category via reverse generation and evaluating the probability that these contexts induce unsafe or biased responses from dialogue models.
